root_causes: The old runtime allowed request/watchdog paths to enter the same rclpy executor generator concurrently.
The old runtime let rclpy own SIGTERM while aiohttp remained in an unconditional sleep loop, so rclpy could close its context without waking the server coroutine or releasing the systemd process.

signal_callback_actions: set one idempotent asyncio shutdown event
cleanup_order: freeze and cancel manual hold watchdog
if hold was active, attempt existing all-surface zero stop once in a bounded daemon worker
clean aiohttp runner with an explicit timeout
destroy node then shutdown rclpy under the single ROS owner lock in a bounded daemon worker
shutdown_contract.first_publish_latency_invariant: first in-process publish remains before sleep or discovery wait

first_migration_boundary.future_gate: The next deployed version must emit shutdown_requested and shutdown_stopped and exit on a normal exact-service restart without SIGKILL.
